rules.pattern: CadQuery unavailable; dedicated CI CAD job installs requirements-cad.txt
rules.reason: The independent CAD job installs the optional CAD dependency and requires the export tests.

rules.pattern: CadQuery is available; covered by the CAD export integration test
rules.reason: The duplicate unit path is intentionally skipped when the dedicated export integration test owns the case.

rules.pattern: O_NOFOLLOW provides atomic POSIX symlink rejection
rules.reason: This test exercises the non-POSIX symlink precheck; POSIX uses atomic O_NOFOLLOW coverage in the adjacent tests.
scikit-learn is a declared runtime dependency; install failure is not an optional pass.
PyYAML is a declared runtime dependency; install failure is not an optional pass.
FastAPI is a declared runtime dependency; install failure is not an optional pass.

gate_policy: UNEXPLAINED, ENVIRONMENT_MISSING, EXTERNAL_BLOCKED, TEMPORARY, and REGRESSION_RISK skips fail blocker gates until explicitly waived by reviewed policy. EXPECTED_OPTIONAL is reported and may pass.
